main_text.p: Jobi 31.39. Ithpahel התנפח אתנפח Inflari. Vide quoque in פּוּחַ. נָפַח נָפְחָא Ch. Faber, quasi sufflator dictus, נָפַח מִפְרְזְלָא Faber ex ferro, id est, ferrarius, Jesa.44.12.

נָפְחָא מְפַח Ch. Sufflatio, inflatio, spiratio, inspiratio, anhelitus: Item Exspiratio, moeror, quia moerore tandem anima exspirat; מְפַחַת נֶפֶשׁ Moeror animae, Deut.28.65. Jobi 11.20. Plur. מְפַחִין Insufflationes ignis, Psal.11.6.
נָפַט Ch. Pix, רְמָא עֲלֵיהוֹן נָפְטָא וְאִשְׁתָּא Projecit in eos picem & ignem, Exo.14.24. in T. Hierosol.
נֻפְטָא Syr. Lucerna, Plur. נֻפְטָיָא, Johan.18.3.

נָפַל Ch. & Syr. Cadere, accidere, concidere, decidere, excidere, incidere, procidere, dejicere vel demittere se, ruere, irruere, corruere. Aphel אַפֵּל Cadere vel Decidere fecit, sivit, abjecit, dejecit, ejecit, projecit, prostravit.
נָפְלָא, נְפוּלָא Ch. Abortus, abortivum, Pf.58.9. Job.3.16.
מַפְלָא, מִפְלָא Ch. Casus, Ruina. Const. מַפְלַת.
נָפְלָא Ch. Orion, vel Arcturus, sydus coeleste, Jobi 38.32. Plural. cum Aff. וּנְפִילֵיהוֹן Et Oriones, Sydera eorum, Jesa.13.10.
נְפוּלָא Ch. Cantharus, locustae species, Levit.11.22. in Jon. Respondet Hebr. חַרְגּוֹל.
נָפַס Ch. Excutere linum, Esth.1.11. Exo.35.26. in Jonath. Idem quod sequens נָפַץ.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are transcribed approximately from the scan; vowel points and small superscript marks are uncertain. The final word at lower right is a catchword-like Hebrew entry and is given as a paragraph.
